rows.source:
While in Adventures:
- Critters may be LOCKED OUT of gossips/dates. They might
   also move to new locations.
- All other quest progress will be put on hold.
- You can abandon the adventure using the Pause menu.

rows.source:
Some stories are best experienced in a closed environment!

During an adventure, many interactions will be limited to keep the story in focus!
